title: Find K-Length Substrings With No Repeated Characters
summary: Determine the count of substrings within a specified string that are exactly k characters long and contain no repeating characters.
statement: Determine the count of substrings within a specified string that are exactly k characters long and contain no repeating characters.
constraints: Count length-k substrings whose characters are all distinct.
Return zero when k exceeds the string length.
hints: A fixed-length sliding window needs character frequencies to test uniqueness.
Add the entering character and remove the leaving one when length exceeds k.
Count a full window exactly when its map has k keys.
A length-k window has k distinct characters precisely under that condition.
editorial: A length-k window has k distinct characters precisely under that condition.
